title: Dell security advisory (AV26-934)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-934 Date: September 17, 2026 As of September 17, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Dell Networking OS10 Prior to 10.6.1.3 Dell OpenManage Server Administrator (OMSA) Multiple versions and models Elastic Cloud Storage (ECS) Prior to 4.4.0.0 ObjectScale Prior to 4.4.0.0 Dell Update Package (DUP) Framework Prior to 26.07.03 Dell Wyse Management Suite Prior to 2605.0.3.683 Dell Repository Manager (DRM) Prior to 3.5.2 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. DSA-2026-343: Security Update for Dell Networking OS10 Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-403: Security Update for Dell OpenManage Server Administrator (OMSA) Network Access Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-393: Security update for Dell ObjectScale Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-417: Security update for Dell Update Package (DUP) Framework Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-387: Security Update for Dell Wyse Management Suite (WMS) for Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-419: Security Update for Dell Repository Manager (DRM) Vulnerability Security Advisories, Notices and Resources Article Link: Dell security advisory (AV26-934
